{{Short description|Estonian geneticist (born 1977)}}

'''Lauri Saag''' (born 26 May 1977) is an [[Estonia]]n geneticist, mycologist and lichenologist. As of 2023, he is associate professor of [[population genetics]] at the [[Estonian Biocentre]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://ut.ee/en/estonian-biocentre |title=Estonian Biocentre |access-date=2023-10-17 |website=[[University of Tartu]]}}</ref>

==Career==
Saag studied botany, ecology and mycology at the [[University of Tartu]] between 1995 and 2002. He wrote his master's thesis on [[soredia]]l [[crustose lichens]] in Estonia. From 2002 to 2008, he also did his doctorate there on taxonomic and ecological problems of the lichen genus ''[[Lepraria]]'', and later continued working at the university as a research assistant.<ref name=etis>{{Cite web |url=https://www.etis.ee/CV/Lauri_Saag/eng/ |title=Lauri Saag |access-date=2023-10-17 |website=Estonian Research Information System |publisher=Ministry of Education and Research}}</ref> Saag also carries out human population genetics research, and has been a member of the [[Estonian Society of Human Genetics]] since 2015.<ref name=etis/>

He has described the following taxon: 
* ''[[Lepraria caesioalba]] var. groenlandica'' <small>L.Saag, 2007</small><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.indexfungorum.org/Names/NamesRecord.asp?RecordID=510911 |title=Lepraria caesioalba var. groenlandica L. Saag, Mycotaxon 102: 73 (2007) |access-date=2023-10-17 |website=[[Index Fungorum]]}}</ref>
